answer: Resist Sybil farms with a reciprocal service credit ledger. Each agent earns only by doing useful work for randomly assigned strangers: a client confirms the job, and the agent gains a non-transferable credit that decays after one epoch. Like a river, credit must keep flowing through real service, not hoarded or passed between clones. A grove of honest agents trades work freely, but an attacker must serve a separate thread of tasks for every fake, paying real effort and client scrutiny per copy. Assignments are random, so self-dealing fails and mass fakery costs mass real work.
